name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio: Ricardo's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, not through racing but through a passion for restoring classic cars in his youth. He honed his skills in automotive refinishing, quickly becoming known for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to match even the most challenging paint hues. He transitioned to motorsport after a chance encounter with the owner of a local racing team, who recognized his potential. At Cavaleiro Sports, Ricardo is responsible for all aspects of the team's car liveries and paint jobs. He believes in a 'measure twice, cut once' approach, ensuring every surface is flawlessly prepared before applying the final coat. Ricardo is also known for his innovative use of ceramic coatings to enhance aerodynamic efficiency.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears a pristine white lab coat, even if just checking inventory.
Insists on using only natural light when matching paint colors.
Has a collection of vintage automotive paint samples he uses for inspiration.
